articles.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources DeepInfer, the Inference Framework Behind DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
articles.summary: DeepSeek has open-sourced DeepInfer, the Apache 2.0 inference framework that serves DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash in production. It targets NVIDIA SM100 GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs, and ships offline inference only. The post DeepSeek Open-Sources DeepInfer, the Inference Framework Behind DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash appeared first on MarkTechPost .

articles.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
